name: Cleveland Public Library - Main Library
description: The system's flagship downtown branch, housing the Louis Stokes Wing and public restrooms open to all library patrons.
accessNote: Open during library hours; closed Sundays.

name: West Side Market
description: Cleveland's historic 1912 public market in Ohio City, with public restrooms inside the market hall.
accessNote: Market hours only: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat 8am-5pm and Sun 10am-4pm. Closed Tue and Thu.

name: Cleveland Museum of Art
description: Major encyclopedic art museum in University Circle with free general admission and public restrooms throughout the galleries.
accessNote: Free general admission. Closed Mondays.

name: Cleveland Museum of Natural History
description: Natural history museum in University Circle. The ground-floor Visitor Hall and its restrooms are free to enter without a ticket.
accessNote: Open Tue-Sun 10am-5pm, closed Mondays. Visitor Hall restrooms are free; galleries are ticketed.

name: Cleveland Botanical Garden
description: University Circle botanical garden with indoor and outdoor restrooms for ticketed visitors.
accessNote: Paid admission required. Closed Mondays.

name: Great Lakes Science Center
description: Hands-on science museum on North Coast Harbor with ADA-accessible and family restrooms on Level 2.
accessNote: Paid admission. Closed for home Browns games.

name: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
description: I.M. Pei-designed museum on the downtown lakefront. Restrooms are inside the ticketed exhibit space.
accessNote: Ticketed admission required. Open daily 10am-5pm.

name: RTA Tower City Station
description: Downtown rail hub beneath Tower City Center at Public Square, with restrooms in the transit concourse.
accessNote: Past the fare gates, so primarily for transit riders. Station hours only.

name: Cleveland Hopkins International Airport
description: Cleveland's main commercial airport, with public restrooms both before and after security in the main terminal.
accessNote: Pre-security restrooms are open to anyone 24/7. Past TSA you need a boarding pass.

name: Public Square
description: Cleveland's 10-acre civic gathering space at the centre of downtown.
accessNote: No restroom in the square itself. The nearest are inside Tower City or the Main Library, both a short walk away.

name: Playhouse Square
description: The largest performing arts centre outside New York City. Restrooms are inside the individual theatre lobbies.
accessNote: Lobby restrooms are generally open only during performances, events, or box office hours.

name: Edgewater Park Beach House
description: Cleveland Metroparks lakefront park on the near west side. The Beach House has on-site public restrooms.
accessNote: Seasonal. Roughly 11am-8pm in peak season, reduced after Labor Day.

name: Euclid Beach Park
description: Former amusement park site, now a Metroparks lakefront beach and pier with a restroom near the pavilion.
accessNote: Seasonal facility. Expect reduced or no access outside the summer beach season.

name: Rocky River Reservation - South Mastick Picnic Area
description: A large picnic area in Rocky River Reservation with a shelter house, ball field, and public restrooms.
street: Valley Pkwy, south of Puritas Rd
accessNote: No street address; find it off Valley Parkway. Daylight hours in season, closed in winter.

name: Brookside Reservation
description: A 132-acre Metroparks reservation in the Big Creek Valley with sports fields, picnic areas, and restrooms.
accessNote: Reservation open 6am-11pm. Restroom access may be limited to the fields and picnic season.

name: Wendy Park at Whiskey Island
description: A 25-acre lakefront park near downtown with beach, trails, kayak access, and on-site public restrooms.
accessNote: Park open daily. Restrooms likely reduced outside warm weather.

name: Huntington Beach
description: Metroparks Lake Erie swimming beach in Bay Village, with changing rooms and ADA-accessible restrooms.
accessNote: Reservation open 6am-11pm. Full beach-house access runs roughly early June to mid-August.

name: Progressive Field
description: Home ballpark of the Cleveland Guardians in downtown Cleveland. Restrooms are inside the concourses.
accessNote: Event access only. You need a game ticket or event credential.

name: Huntington Bank Field
description: Lakefront stadium of the Cleveland Browns. Restrooms are inside the concourses.
accessNote: Event access only. You need a game ticket or event credential.

name: Rocket Arena
description: Downtown arena for the Cleveland Cavaliers, formerly Rocket Mortgage FieldHouse. Restrooms are inside the concourses.
accessNote: Event access only. You need a game or event ticket.

name: Cleveland State University Student Center
description: CSU's main student union on Euclid Avenue, with public restrooms near the dining and lounge areas.
accessNote: Open to the public during building hours. Reduced when the university is out of session.

name: Tinkham Veale University Center
description: Case Western Reserve University's student union in University Circle, with restrooms near the food court and lobby.
accessNote: Open to visitors during building hours. Reduced when the university is out of session.

name: Perk Plaza Portland Loo
description: One of Cleveland's first standalone public toilets: a freestanding, gender-neutral Portland Loo in Perk Plaza downtown.
accessNote: Part of the city's 2025-2026 rollout and still being commissioned as of early 2026. Check before relying on it.

name: Canal Basin Park Portland Loo
description: Two freestanding Portland Loo public restrooms at Canal Basin Park in the Flats.
accessNote: Installed but awaiting utility hookups as of early 2026, with no set hours yet. Check before relying on it.

name: Payne Avenue Portland Loo
description: Cuyahoga County's first Portland Loo: a freestanding, ADA-accessible public restroom outside the Virgil E. Brown service centre.
accessNote: Free, standalone and gender-neutral. Installed 2025 to serve nearby shelters as well as the public.
